download_bert_models: download pretrained BERT base uncased model and vocabulary files to a specified data path
download_bert_with_version: download BERT models to a data path with a custom version string for version tracking
upgrade_bert_models: upgrade outdated BERT model files by removing the old version and downloading the latest
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how BERT models are fetched and versioned
refactor_download_urls: refactor the download function to use a different source URL for BERT model files
